notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least five.
description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.
